modern-current-2026-ga.title: Pushbuild2026 GA official-source returns snapshot
modern-current-2026-ga.license: CC0-1.0 research snapshot; original official-source URLs retained per contest

limitations: This is a same-seat first-November-ballot comparison, not a comparison of final deciding rounds or identical nominees.
The 2020 general ballot required a January 5, 2021 runoff; that runoff and the separate 2020 special seat are excluded. The 2026 December 1 date is a conditional later round, not an outcome claim.
The normalized 2020 stage remains first round and original sourceStage remains general. No global regular-stage guard is changed.
The 2020 presidential-cycle versus 2026 midterm setting, different candidate field, provisional counting, population changes and voting rules limit interpretation.

All 477 prior county cells match the pinned upstream research release, and all three column totals match independent FEC full-term November controls. That aggregate check is not an independent county audit.

Current 318 county cells and both state controls reconcile within the same existing registered snapshot. Fresh primary API access returned 403; no fresh direct current count-vector endorsement is claimed.

FEC generic PRIMARY/RUNOFF/GENERAL column headers do not directly identify the Georgia November and January stages; the exact dates, full-term candidate vector and Georgia SOS event labels are used together.
Race vote sums are not unique turnout or ballots cast. Explicit third-party counts remain unassigned; no null-to-zero substitution or winner promotion.
County inventory and atlas FIPS are unchanged. This bounded check identifies no boundary change in these sources; it is not a new legal boundary survey.
Any pinned source file, candidate vector, stage, quality flag or event-date change requires renewed qualification.
